metadata.title: Dynamical evolution of Milky Way globular clusters on the cosmological timescale I. Mass loss and interaction with the nuclear star cluster

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies globular clusters (e.g., T:p12-b2), not individual Galactic unbound stars. Its references to “unbound stars” concern stars unbound from their globular clusters or being tested for binding to the nuclear star cluster (e.g., T:p1-b16, T:p9-b12), not stars unbound from the Milky Way. No individual star identifiers are supplied.
